change: Add non-blocking active shared-stream cancellation, deadline-bounded retirement joins, and asynchronous owning-handle destruction

reference.observed_contract: CallState::Cancel atomically publishes cancellation once and schedules a transport cancel batch through the call combiner while references own asynchronous completion

before.public_cancel: acquired the shared State mutex without a deadline and then waited unconditionally for retired_event
before.owning_deinit: called the same unbounded cancel-and-join path
before.risk: a surface cancellation or destructor could remain blocked behind unrelated state ownership or a stalled endpoint cleanup

public_api.requestCancel: atomic publication plus endpoint wake, with no State mutex or retirement wait
public_api.cancelWithDeadline: one caller-owned awake deadline bounds the optional retirement join
public_api.cancelWithTimeout: relative timeout converted once before the same bounded join
public_api.deinit: requests cancellation and releases the user reference without joining

real_tcp_fixture.following_rpc: successful on the same HTTP/2 connection

interop.matrix: multiplexed duplex cancellation isolation, shared duplex asynchronous cancellation plus bounded join and unary reuse, shared unary and duplex, health gating, metadata, compression, deadline and soak
